discovery: meta.timestamp_contract on new P07 confirm receipts, current P07 reads/reconciliation envelope and opt-in P22 reads

serialization.precision: Retain persisted precision; zero-padding is not additional measurement accuracy

storage.postgres: The selected runtime columns are timestamptz. New NFC inserts and updates bind strings including an explicit offset, preserving microseconds.
storage.sqlite: New values retain their explicit offset. Legacy naive NFC fixture values follow the existing Vietnam wall-clock convention.

surfaces: GET /api/v1/mini-app/items/{itemId}/nfc/confirmation - outer envelope; nested persisted receipt remains unchanged
POST /api/v1/mini-app/nfc/resolve-code and /resolve-tag - existing read resolver nfc projection
P22 opt-in P08 history records/detail/summary - persisted audit event time

audit.writer: Capture an aware original event time before ORM date casting and outbox serialization. The canonical insert retains that offset through Eloquent.
audit.outbox: Publication uses the captured event time, never publication time or a new lookup. Legacy naive queued values retain the previous binding behavior; this patch does not invent provenance.
audit.other_actions: Existing date format and behavior unchanged

p22.scope: Existing actor/session/warehouse/snapshot and audit-details permission checks
p22.query: Normalize the actual timestamp column before upper bound/date filtering, ordering and keyset paging; output RFC3339 from that same normalized value
p22.cursor: Timestamp contract is bound in the existing cursor scope; old cursors are rejected with the existing scope-mismatch policy
p22.date_only: Existing app timezone calendar-date query and exclusive next-day boundary remain unchanged

historical_receipts.policy: Replay original persisted response unchanged, including old timestamp text and absence of the new marker. Do not replace it using the current tag.
historical_receipts.current_mapping_read: Serializes the persisted instant without correcting a bad write

frontend: Parse RFC3339 once, render Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh; equivalent Z/+00:00/+07:00 values represent the same instant. Do not subtract seven hours or relabel offsets on old receipt text.
acceptance: Patch release and read-only runtime binding probe are verified. OPEN for authenticated original-owner GET list/detail/receipt and a separately approved new TEST write/read or equivalent owner evidence. Existing bad row/receipt need a separate data-owner decision. No production or whole-P07 PASS is implied.
